verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the Postman CLI runs whole collections "with extensive configuration options and built-in reporters" (postman-docs-1, postman-docs-32), runs test collections in CI/CD (postman-docs-19), and Newman runs and tests collections from the command line (postman-docs-42). Test scripts provide the assertions that each run evaluates (postman-docs-17, postman-docs-29). A community user also confirms rerunning saved collections for testing (postman-comm-17). missing for 10: explicit documentation of the pass/fail report format/contents (only "built-in reporters" is mentioned), independent hands-on corroboration of the collection runner's reporting.
